meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会通过 agent-browser 命令行控制真实浏览器:打开网址、点击页面元素、填表单、截图或录屏、读取页面内容,并产出截图、PDF 等文件。
howto.when: 当你要打开网站、操作网页或截图等浏览器任务,或需要测试网页应用、抓取页面信息时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com/form,把邮箱和密码填好并点提交,然后截图
say.note: 它会导航、填写、点击并保存截图

say.text: 对比 v1.com 和 v2.com 两个页面,列出差异
say.note: 用 diff url 比较两页快照

say.text: 登录后把登录状态存下来,下次直接复用
say.note: 用 state save 保存认证状态

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives a real browser through the agent-browser command: open URLs, click elements, fill forms, screenshot or record video, and read page data, producing files like screenshots and PDFs.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to open sites, operate web pages, take screenshots, or test and extract information from pages.

say_en.text: Open example.com/form, fill in email and password, submit, then screenshot
say_en.note: It navigates, fills, clicks, and saves a screenshot

say_en.text: Compare v1.com and v2.com and list the differences
say_en.note: Runs diff url on both pages

say_en.text: Log in, save the session state, and reuse it next time
say_en.note: Uses state save to store auth
